definitions.explanation: Showing strong motivation and enthusiasm; actively seeking to achieve or improve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{意欲的|いよくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: He is tackling work with great motivation.

examples.japanese: {意欲的|いよくてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めています→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for motivated students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{意欲的|いよくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {意欲的|いよくてき} is commonly used in work and academic contexts to describe someone who actively engages with tasks. Can be used as な-adjective or adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

NOUN: ⟦{意欲|いよく}→意欲：05317_iyoku⟧ (motivation, enthusiasm, will)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意欲的|いよくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (tackle enthusiastically)
- {意欲的|いよくてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (motivated attitude)
- {意欲的|いよくてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (ambitious work)
- {意欲的|いよくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (eagerly take on challenges)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: Proactive, assertive (emphasis on taking initiative)
- {意欲的|いよくてき}: Ambitious, motivated (emphasis on strong desire)
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: To be motivated (casual expression)
